context: A retired exec mentors a younger boss on management discipline
purpose: Teach: 担っ/書き込ん/専念/県警/整合/図り/出題/一律

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 担っている責任の重さ、忘れるなよ。
lines.en: Don't forget the weight of the responsibility you carry.
lines.style: Quiet authority. Speaks as if sharing something he learned at great cost. Steady gaze. No rush — each word lands with intention. The tone of someone who knows what he's saying matters.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。専念して取り組む案件が増えています。
lines.en: Yes. Cases requiring dedicated focus are growing.
lines.style: Direct, businesslike. Crisp on the affirmative. Matter-of-fact about the growing caseload — this is the state of things, stated without complaint. Composed postural alignment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 資料には自分の手で書き込んでおけ。あとで整合性が活きる。
lines.en: Write directly into the materials yourself. The consistency will matter later.
lines.style: Measured instruction, not harsh. Slight emphasis on 「自分の手で」 — this detail is why he's saying it. Patient but firm. The cadence of someone who has seen what happens when this step is skipped.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 承知しました。県警対応も、図り直して進めます。
lines.en: Understood. Prefectural-police coordination — I'll rework the approach and move forward.
lines.style: Respectful commitment. Clipped, efficient delivery. Eyes track slightly upward with the acknowledgment. No defensiveness — just the clear intake of instruction and the immediate acceptance of the workload.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 出題された課題、一律対応で逃げるな。個別の論点を吟味しろ。
lines.en: On posed problems, don't resort to uniform answers. Examine each issue individually.
lines.style: Authoritative but not unkind. Slight lean forward on the warning. Deliberate pace. The tone of someone correcting a pattern he's noticed — not contempt, but expectation that the listener can do better.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Formal, sincere. Quiet reverence in the tone — not performed, but genuine. A beat of settling after receiving something important. The words sit weightily, fully absorbed.
